title: 5G NR Multicell Twin — SionnaRT-Veg, MEASURED crowns (CBH B), 28 GHz
variant: P.833 measured crowns, CBH B = 0.35 x tree height (LiDAR crown top)

grid.cell_order: row-major, index = ri*25+ci; ri indexes ys (-480 -> +480), ci indexes xs (-480 -> +480), ENU metres about tile centre 37.801105, -122.404175. Identical to the v8 page SIONNA28 order.

sector_order: [625][48] columns are cell-major: S00-1,S00-2,S00-3, S01-1,S01-2,S01-3, ... S33-1,S33-2,S33-3 — 16 small cells in TWS28 order (S00..S03 south row, S10..S13, S20..S23, S30..S33 north row) x sectors 90/210/330 deg, matching the v8 page rsrps() order (TWS28 ti, then si 0,1,2).

provenance.method: ITU-R P.833-10 Eq.(1) foliage loss applied post-trace to the Sionna 28 GHz ray-traced small-cell grid. Loss per small-cell-receiver pair, applied equally to all 3 sectors of that cell. phi = 1 for LOS pairs, 0 for non-LOS (lower bound).
provenance.crowns: Measured: NAIP 2022 4-band 0.6 m imagery, NDVI gate 0.15 seeded at the 1,919 DataSF surveyed tree points; LiDAR crown top from OSM-masked 3DEP CHM sampled only inside the NDVI footprints; 1,503/1,919 trees measured, 416 fell back to the DBH rule. Crown base CBH B = 0.35 x LiDAR tree height.
source_files: results_28ghz_smallcell_street.npz (rsrp_tilt4, 16 cells x 3 sectors, 8 m AGL, EIRP 40 dBm, tilt 4 deg)
6g-ran-multicell-handoff-v8.html (SIONNA28 embedded grid, verified identical to rsrp_tilt4 to 1 d.p. rounding, max 0.05 dB, NaN pattern identical)
provenance.checks: rsrp_veg verified = rsrp_tilt4 + veg_adj broadcast over sectors (max diff <1e-4 dB); NaN pattern identical to no-veg grid (23,415 nulls of 30,000 entries).

notes_for_claude: Load rsrp_dbm as the new SIONNA28V (same xs/ys, same [625][16][3] layout after reshaping each row to [16][3] cell-major). Update the v8 comparison note: trees mean -1.62 dB (was -1.35), 8.2% cells >1 dB (was 7.2%), worst -39.3 dB (was -41.4); coverage 29.8% (was 29.9%) and median -98.6 dBm (was -98.1 dBm). Keep the P.833 lower-bound wording and the (gamma,Am) interpolated caveat. This is the measured-crown P.833 run only, NOT the native solid-crown run (tower-A-only, separate).
